name: Active Directory & Windows Pentesting
name_si: Active Directory සහ Windows ආරක්ෂණ පරීක්ෂාව
description: Enterprise Windows domain architecture, Kerberos authentication, ticket attacks, lateral movement, BloodHound mapping, and credential extraction.
description_si: ව්‍යාපාරික Windows Domain ව්‍යුහය, Kerberos සහ NTLM අනන්‍යතාව තහවුරු කිරීම, AS-REP Roasting, Pass-the-Hash, BloodHound විශ්ලේෂණය සහ Privilege Escalation.

name: Web Application Security (OWASP Top 10)
description: Deep-dive into modern web vulnerabilities: SQLi, NoSQLi, LDAPi, XXE, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, SSTI, Insecure Deserialization, and Race Conditions.
description_si: වෙබ් අඩවි සහ යෙදුම් වල ප්‍රධාන දුර්වලතා: SQL Injection, NoSQL, LDAP, XXE, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, SSTI, Insecure Deserialization සහ Race Conditions ප්‍රායෝගිකව ඉගෙනීම.

name: HTTP Protocols & Smuggling Techniques
description: HTTP Keep-Alive, HTTP/1.1 Request Smuggling (CL.TE / TE.CL), HTTP/2 Smuggling, WebSocket Desync, and Same-Origin Policy (SOP).
description_si: HTTP/1.1 සහ HTTP/2 දත්ත හුවමාරු ක්‍රම, Request Smuggling, Keep-Alive/Pipelining ගැටළු, WebSocket Smuggling සහ Same-Origin Policy (SOP).

name: API & Token Security (JWT & OAuth 2.0)
description: JSON Web Token (JWT) pentesting, algorithm confusion (alg:none, RS256 to HS256), OAuth 2.0 grant types, and redirect URI manipulation.
description_si: API සහ Token ආරක්ෂාව, JWT දුර්වලතා (alg:none, Secret Cracking, Key Confusion), OAuth 2.0 ක්‍රමෝපායන් සහ Account Takeover ප්‍රහාර.

name: Secure Source Code Auditing
description: White-box security auditing for PHP (type juggling, sink analysis), Flask/Python (SSTI, Werkzeug console PIN exploit), and JavaScript Prototype Pollution.
description_si: ප්‍රභව කේත පරීක්ෂාව (Code Review): PHP Type Juggling, අනතුරුදායක Sinks, Flask/Python SSTI සහ JavaScript Prototype Pollution ප්‍රහාර.

name: Linux Privilege Escalation
description: Sudo permissions abuse, GTFOBins exploitation, automated enumeration with LinPEAS, SUID binaries, cron jobs, and capabilities.
description_si: Linux මෙහෙයුම් පද්ධතියේ සාමාන්‍ය පරිශීලකයෙකුගෙන් Root තත්වයට බලතල වැඩි කරගැනීම: Sudo Abuse, GTFOBins, LinPEAS, SUID සහ Cron Jobs.

name: Reconnaissance, Shells & Metasploit
description: Burp Suite masterclass, pentest methodology, fuzzing wordlists, reverse & bind shells, Metasploit Framework, Meterpreter payloads, Msfvenom, and Wi-Fi security.
description_si: Burp Suite භාවිතය, Fuzzing සහ Wordlists, Reverse Shells, Metasploit Framework, Msfvenom Payloads, Vulnerability Databases සහ Wi-Fi 802.11 ආරක්ෂාව.

name: Defensive Security, SOC & Cloud
name_si: ආරක්ෂණ තාක්ෂණය, SOC සහ Cloud Security
description: Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, SIEM/EDR, Threat Modeling (STRIDE/PASTA), Cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP IAM, S3, IMDS), and DevSecOps pipelines.
description_si: ආරක්ෂක මෙහෙයුම් මධ්‍යස්ථාන (SOC) කාර්යභාරය, SIEM/EDR, Threat Modeling (STRIDE, PASTA), Cloud Security (AWS/Azure/GCP) සහ DevSecOps ක්‍රමවේද.

name: Red Teaming, LLM & Mobile Security
name_si: Red Teaming, AI/LLM Pentesting සහ Mobile
description: Red Team operations, MITRE ATT&CK matrix, LLM prompt injection and jailbreaking, and Android/iOS mobile application reverse engineering.
description_si: Red Team ප්‍රහාරක උපායමාර්ග, Large Language Models (LLM) Pentesting, Prompt Injection, සහ Mobile Applications (Android APK) ආරක්ෂණ පරීක්ෂාව.

name: Machine Walkthroughs, Exploits & Reports
name_si: ප්‍රායෝගික Machines, Exploits සහ Pentest Reports
description: Full walkthroughs for TryHackMe machines (Orion, Abducted, Nexus), Python exploit scripts (mfaexploit.py), and professional security assessment reports.
description_si: TryHackMe Machines පියවරෙන් පියවර විසඳුම් (Orion, Abducted, Nexus), Python Exploit Scripts (mfaexploit.py) සහ සත්‍ය Penetration Testing Reports.
